items.title: Inside Out: Evolving User-Centric Core Memory Trees for Long-Term Personalized Dialogue Systems
items.title_zh: 由内而外：为长期个性化对话系统演化以用户为中心的核心记忆树
items.summary: Inside Out maintains a PersonaTree as a long-term user profile, constraining the trunk with an initial schema and updating branches and leaves to compress memory while preserving persona consistency. A lightweight MemListener trained with reinforcement learning and process-based rewards produces ADD, UPDATE, DELETE and NO_OP operations, with the small model matching or surpassing much larger reasoning models on memory-operation decisions.

items.title: PRISM: Protocol Refinement through Intelligent Simulation Modeling
items.title_zh: PRISM：通过智能仿真建模进行实验协议优化
items.summary: PRISM uses language-model agents to gather procedures, convert them into structured experimental steps through planning, critique and validation loops, and translate them into a robotic-lab protocol format. Protocols are checked in an NVIDIA Omniverse digital twin before execution, with Luna qPCR amplification and Cell Painting as case studies.

items.title: Improving Enzyme Prediction with Chemical Reaction Equations by Hypergraph-Enhanced Knowledge Graph Embeddings
items.title_zh: 利用化学反应方程式与超图增强知识图谱嵌入改进酶预测
items.summary: The paper represents chemical reaction equations as (educt, enzyme, product) triples in a knowledge graph and combines a hypergraph transformer with knowledge graph embedding to infer missing enzyme–substrate pairs. It reports up to 88% relative improvement in average enzyme retrieval accuracy and 30% in pair-level prediction over traditional models.

items.title: LELA: an LLM-based Entity Linking Approach with Zero-Shot Domain Adaptation
items.title_zh: LELA：具备零样本领域自适应能力的基于 LLM 的实体链接方法
items.summary: LELA is a modular coarse-to-fine entity-linking approach that uses large language models without any fine-tuning and works across target domains, knowledge bases and LLMs. Experiments show it is highly competitive with fine-tuned methods and substantially outperforms non-fine-tuned ones.

items.title: Multi-Disciplinary Dataset Discovery from Citation-Verified Literature Contexts
items.title_zh: 基于引用验证文献上下文的多学科数据集发现
items.summary: The framework discovers datasets from citation contexts in scientific papers, combining large-scale citation-context extraction, schema-guided recognition with LLMs and provenance-preserving entity resolution. On eight survey-derived computer science queries it reports normalized recall from 47.47% to 81.82%, higher than Google Dataset Search and DataCite Commons.

items.title: Efficient Inference for Noisy LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
items.title_zh: 含噪 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估的高效推断
items.summary: The paper compares measurement-error correction and prediction-powered inference for estimating mean parameters from noisy LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, unifying both under semiparametric efficiency theory and characterizing when PPI-style estimators have strictly smaller asymptotic variance. Results are verified in simulations and real-data examples, with an implementation released.

items.title: Chain-of-Sanitized-Thoughts: Plugging PII Leakage in CoT of Large Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 净化思维链：堵住大型推理模型 CoT 中的 PII 泄露
items.summary: The paper introduces PII-CoT-Bench and studies privacy-first reasoning so models do not expose personally identifiable information in intermediate chain-of-thought. It finds state-of-the-art models benefit most from prompt-based controls while weaker models need fine-tuning, with both approaches substantially reducing leakage at minimal utility cost.

items.title: Same Claim, Different Judgment: Benchmarking Scenario-Induced Bias in Multilingual Financial Misinformation Detection
items.title_zh: 同一说法，不同判断：多语言金融虚假信息检测中的情境诱导偏差基准
items.summary: MFMDScen pairs complex financial scenarios—varying role and personality, role and region, and role with ethnicity and religious beliefs—with multilingual misinformation claims in English, Chinese, Greek and Bengali. Evaluating 22 mainstream LLMs, it finds pronounced behavioral biases in both commercial and open-source models.

items.title: Netomi’s lessons for scaling agentic systems into the enterprise
items.title_zh: Netomi 将智能体系统扩展到企业规模的经验
items.summary: OpenAI describes how Netomi scales enterprise AI agents with GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.2, combining concurrency, governance and multi-step reasoning for reliable production workflows.
